Graduate Design Engineer - Electric Vehicles

About the job
Join our battery-systems group as a graduate design engineer. From your first
week you will own small parts of real vehicle programmes.

Responsibilities
- Produce CAD models and drawings in SolidWorks.
- Run thermal simulations and report results to senior engineers.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering (2024 or 2025).
- Project experience with CAD and simulation tools.

Preferred
- Formula Student or similar team project.
